prompt: A cinematic film still captures a quiet moment in a snowy town square. On the left, an old woman in a blue coat stands beside a black lantern post. In the center, a young boy in a yellow hat points toward the right side of the frame. A brown dog sits patiently next to the boy, looking up at him with attentive eyes. On the right, a man in a green scarf holds out a small paper bag, handing it to the boy. Behind them, a wooden bench remains empty under a layer of fresh snow. There is no visible smoke rising from any chimneys. The scene is frozen in time, highlighting the stark contrast between the vibrant clothing and the white surroundings. The interaction between the man and the boy suggests a simple exchange, while the dog's presence adds warmth to the chilly atmosphere. The old woman observes silently from her position on the left, creating a balanced composition across the square. The snow covers every surface uniformly, emphasizing the stillness of the environment.
